title: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest was a big buyer of Anthropic during debut
html:
Cathie Wood was a major buyer of Anthropic following its debut Thursday on the Nasdaq, buying shares in all her major funds.

Wood's firm, which already owned private shares of the AI company in its ARK Venture Fund leading up to the IPO, bought $90.8 million worth of Anthropic in six funds, according to a trade notification from the firm.

The stakes are relatively small across the funds, but Wood typically will buy shares in companies she likes steadily during long stretches.

In her $6.1 billion ARK Innovation ETF, Anthropic is a 0.3% stake. The biggest holdings in that fund are Tesla and SpaceX, representing more than 21% of the fund together.

ARK Innovation, which retail investors piled into during the pandemic as it gained about 150% in 2020, tumbled the subsequent next two years, losing 67% in 2022 alone. Wood's following was dented after the big losses.

The fund had a comeback stretch as the bull market revved back up from 2023 to 2025, but has fallen on hard times again this year, down more than 10% in 2026. The S&P 500 is up 4.8% this year.

Anthropic shares jumped 17% in their first day, but closed well off the lows and were lower again in premarket trading Friday.
summary: Wood's firm bought $90.8 million worth of Anthropic in six funds, according to a trade notification from the firm.
